prompt: A ringing bell signal, pixel art, plays once, about 0.7 seconds. Three golden curved sound-wave arcs expand outward to both sides from the centre with a few bright sparkles, then fade. Colours: gold, warm yellow, white. Transparent background, crisp pixels, about 64 pixels across, centred, no text.
message: A one-shot bell ring of about 0.7 s on a 64×64 transparent canvas: a small gold flash at the centre, then three gold-to-white arcs expand out to both sides and fade, with white sparkles twinkling around them. Colours are gold, warm yellow and white. I haven't added sliders, so the arc timing and sparkle count are set in the recipe.
